detail.description:
One of the classic hike-up whitewater runs that flows into the Middle Fork Salmon, and likely the most challenging one that is commonly paddled.

[In Love With Frank](https://vimeo.com/169925036) from [Seth Dahl](https://vimeo.com/user5065930) on [Vimeo](https://vimeo.com).

Lat / Longitude data are _very_ approximate.

Alternate putin: Silver Creek, if the gate isn't locked.
